note: Same-origin data files a shipped script fetches at RUNTIME. The markup references none of these, so no other stage can see them; a build without them renders a shell and passes parity, because parity compares two equally empty static documents. Served at their ORIGINAL path — the caller is a string literal this pipeline cannot rewrite.
unresolvedNote: An interpolated or cross-origin runtime endpoint. Not fetched: an interpolated path is a SERVER and a static clone has no server, and a cross-origin one belongs to somebody else. Both are reported so the build states what it cannot serve.
